item.title: Massage in Dubai
item.description:
This is part of exercises I took in the writing workshop at Esalen in July 2026.

I am in a taxi in Dubai, tired to my bones. The Pakistani taxi driver looks at his rearview mirror and says in a thick Punjabi accented English “You look tired”, “you must have a 200 plus IQ”, I wanted to say, but I merely nodded. Even nodding was painful. I had spent 3 weeks in a hospital taking care of my mother who had it not been for the doctors and nurses would not have made it from the medical shock of sepsis.
